build_dla_backbone: build a DLA backbone network with 34 or 60 layers for object detection feature extraction
build_retinanet_dla_fpn_backbone: build a DLA FPN backbone with P6 and P7 extra levels for RetinaNet detection
create_dlaseg_model: create a DLASeg backbone module with configurable DLAUp and multi-scale output options
create_tree_module: create a recursive Tree module with BasicBlock or Bottleneck for hierarchical feature aggregation
create_idaup_module: create an IDAUp module with deformable convolutions for multi-scale feature upsampling and fusion
